content.comment_body: Hello! Is it possible for [product_name] with [version_no] to collect data from my analog input module via Ethernet? Can you provide an example of how to achieve this? I have a MOXA IOLOGIK E1240, receiving a 4-20mA signal from a temperature sensor (0-160C). I would like to display the data on the small screen of [product_name]. Thanks.
Do you have a manual or a link to the manual?
Hello [user_name], Please find the link below: [url] Best regards.
Hello! Is there any update or answer to the previous question? Thanks.
It is possible in principle. [product_name] needs to act as the client, while the MOXA device functions as the slave.
If you had tried searching the forum, you might have found the topic: Reading MOXA values in [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion centers on whether [product_name] with [version_no] can acquire analog data from a MOXA IOLOGIK E1240 module over Ethernet and display it. The original question seeks clear guidance or a working example for this setup. Replies generally affirm the possibility but do not offer detailed instructions, leaving the user still seeking practical help.
